On her way to the venue of her debut race, 
Vivlos receives passionate cheers from the 
fans of her mother and older sister, 
Verxina.

Publicly declaring that she would follow 
the same path as her sister would 
naturally raise expectations for the 
Triple Tiara. Would she be able to 
withstand that pressure when the time 
came—?

Brushing aside all such worries, Vivlos 
cheerfully dashed out for her debut race!
